findings.summary: PlanStorageAdapter continues to violate the directional mapping invariant by re-deriving postExitPosture from breach direction and hardcoding swapInstruction to SOL->USDC when reconstructing the exit-previewed state.
findings.suggested_fix: Add a jsonb column (e.g. `lifecycleStateJson`) to store and retrieve the entire PlanLifecycleState object intact, removing the need to fabricate domain-specific preview and executionOrigin structures in the adapter.

findings.summary: FakePlanRepository shares the exact same directional hardcoding defect as PlanStorageAdapter, reconstructing the exit-previewed state with derived postExitPosture and hardcoded SOL->USDC swapInstructions.
findings.suggested_fix: Update the fake to store and return the actual PlanLifecycleState objects in memory rather than decomposing them into scalar fields and rebuilding them with hardcoded data.
